name: adversarial-review
description: Adversarial code review workflows for Claude Code and Codex, with Optimizer/Skeptic review passes and mechanical verification.

interface.shortDescription: Run Optimizer/Skeptic code reviews with Codex or compare against Claude review artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Adversarial Review packages a structured code review workflow with mechanical checks, Optimizer and Skeptic passes, confidence-gated findings, and persistent review artifacts. In Codex, use the adversarial-review skill to run an independent Codex review or compare against Claude-generated artifacts for cross-provider review.
